notes: sap.com returned 403 to direct fetch and curl, so SAP's office-locations page was read only through the search index (Ecoworld 8A and RMZ NXT addresses quoted from it); its full Bengaluru list could not be seen, so the Sattva Softzone and GR Tech Park entries were not confirmed or refuted (Softzone moved to medium, GR Tech Park left low). The Mercedes-Benz careers page also returned 403; its Whitefield Palms address and the 9,156 employee figure come from the search index, and bengaluruEmployeesApprox was not set because that figure covers Bengaluru and Pune. MBRDI's Brigade Tech Gardens office (low) was not re-checked. Verizon: no primary source names the Bengaluru building; Fishbowl blocked direct fetch (403). Star Air: no street address is published by the airline; its Bengaluru office stays an unconfirmed OSM node. Prestige's 12,145 employee figure is FY2022-23 total employees (8,393 permanent) on a consolidated basis; MNC rests on that total. The CoWrks corporate role of the Campus 7 contact address is an inference from the site's contact settings.
